questions.topic: Purpose clause after afin que
questions.learningObjective: Choose the mood after afin que

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

answer.exemplar: Afin que introduces a purpose clause and requires the subjonctif, so 'afin que les voyageurs puissent monter' uses the subjonctif rather than the indicatif.

questions.explanation: Purpose clauses after afin que take the subjonctif. The key value is Afin que introduces a purpose clause and requires the subjonctif, so 'afin que les voyageurs puissent monter' uses the subjonctif rather than the indicatif..

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: One word that changes what a sentence means
questions.learningObjective: Identify the word that flips sentence meaning

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: Parce que marks the cause
options.misconception: treats "Parce que marks the cause" as if it followed from the evidence

options.text: Bien que marks the concession
Donc marks the result
Pourtant marks the contrast

questions.explanation: Bien que introduces a concession, reversing the causal reading. The key is B, "Bien que marks the concession". Option A ("Parce que marks the cause") is wrong: treats "Parce que marks the cause" as if it followed from the evidence. Option C ("Donc marks the result") is wrong: confuses result with cause. Option D ("Pourtant marks the contrast") is wrong: confuses contrast with concession.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Register marked by tu and vous
questions.learningObjective: Choose the register for a formal address

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: Use il for a formal address
Use tu for a formal address
Use vous for a formal or plural address
Use on for a formal address
options.misconception: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes

questions.explanation: Vous marks formal or plural address. The key is C, "Use vous for a formal or plural address". Option A ("Use il for a formal address") is wrong: uses a third person pronoun. Option B ("Use tu for a formal address") is wrong: confuses informal with formal. Option D ("Use on for a formal address") is wrong: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes.
